lines.zh: : 哦，太好了！你回来了。

lines.en: : I was starting to think you secretly hated me and were just never coming back.
lines.zh: : 我都开始觉得，你其实是偷偷讨厌我，打算永远都不回来了。

lines.en: : You think that every time I get up to go to the bathroom.
lines.zh: : 我每次起身去上厕所，你都这么想。

lines.en: : Welcome home, Sensei! I tried to put up mistletoe so we could kiss and no one would be allowed to get mad, but Ami took it down.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，老师！我本来想把槲寄生挂起来，这样我们就能接吻、谁都不许生气，可 Ami 把它摘了。

lines.en: : You taped it to your forehead! Of course I took it down!
lines.zh: : 你把它贴在额头上了！我当然要摘！
: {i}你{/i}有什么毛病吗？
: 我？你什么意思？
: 你看起来……很糟。

lines.en: : Thank you, Maya. You really have a way with words sometimes.
lines.zh: : 谢谢夸奖，Maya。你有时候真是会说话。
: 你知道我是什么意思。

lines.en: Do I really seem so off that even Maya is able to pick up on it?
lines.zh: 我真的有那么不对劲吗，连 Maya 都看得出来？

lines.en: I figured the walk home would be more than enough to clear my head, but...I guess not.
lines.zh: 我本以为走回家这段路，足够让脑子清醒了，可……看来没有。

lines.en: Maybe it’s just the weather again?
lines.zh: 也许又只是天气的缘故？

lines.en: That’s sure as hell a better scapegoat than the probability of me molesting a girl only to be immediately forgiven by her and then...given a gift?
lines.zh: 这可真是个比「我可能性侵了一个女孩，结果立刻被她原谅，然后……还送我礼物？」这个可能性好得多的替罪羊。

lines.en: It’s weird to say this, but I kind of wish Molly was a little more torn up about this than she is.
lines.zh: 说起来挺怪的，但我有点希望 Molly 对这件事能比现在更纠结一点。

lines.en: At least that would justify all of the...{i}feelings{/i} I’ve had since Halloween.
lines.zh: 至少那样，就能为我从万圣节以来所有的……{i}感受{/i}，提供正当理由了。

lines.en: Feelings are annoying. And I’m annoyed that they haven’t started hiding again yet.
lines.zh: 感受真烦人。而它们到现在都还没重新开始躲起来，这让我很烦。

lines.en: : I’m fine. What are all of you up to? I’m not really sure what a pre-Christmas party Christmas party consists of.
lines.zh: : 我没事。你们都在忙什么呢？我不太确定「圣诞前派对的圣诞派对」到底都干些什么。

lines.en: : Just watching movies and eating a bunch of cakes Ayane brought over. There’s some left on the counter if you want any.
lines.zh: : 就是看看电影，吃一堆 Ayane 带来的蛋糕。柜台上还剩一些，你要是想吃就去拿。

lines.en: : No thanks. I’m probably just going to go to sleep early tonight.
lines.zh: : 不了，谢谢。我今晚大概要早点睡。
: 什么？！不行！为什么？

lines.en: : Are you so excited for the real party that you don’t want the {i}pre{/i}-party to spoil it?
lines.zh: : 你是太期待真正的派对，所以不想让{i}前哨{/i}派对把期待感提前用掉吗？

lines.en: : I...didn’t think you were looking forward to it that much, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我……没想到您那么期待啊，老师……

lines.en: : Oh! Um...before I forget...my mom wanted me to ask if...you could come help decorate the bar tomorrow morning...
lines.zh: : 哦！嗯……趁我还没忘……我妈想让我问问您……明天上午能不能过去帮忙布置酒吧……

lines.en: : Why? So she can have something to stare at when the place is inevitably dead all night?
lines.zh: : 为什么？好让她在店里不可避免地整晚冷清的时候，有点东西可以盯着看？
: 太狠了。

lines.en: : They’re...having a Christmas party...and she actually expects it to be busy...
lines.zh: : 他们……要办圣诞派对……而且她是真的指望会忙起来……

lines.en: : Well good for her for never giving up hope.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她从不放弃希望，这点挺好的。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse me-
lines.zh: : 那么，请恕我失陪——

lines.en: : No! You really can’t leave yet! Not until Niki shows up!
lines.zh: : 不行！您真的还不能走！至少等 Niki 出现再说！
: 等等，Niki 要来？为什么？

lines.en: : Well...no. But she’s performing a new Christmas song for a variety show tonight and you have to be here for it!
lines.zh: : 嗯……不是来。但她今晚要在一个综艺节目上表演一首新的圣诞歌，您必须得在这儿看！

lines.en: : But I don’t even really like Niki’s music. It’s too...pink.
lines.zh: : 可我其实并不怎么喜欢 Niki 的音乐。太……粉了。

lines.en: : I don’t care how much I love you. In this house, we treat Niki Nakayama with respect.
lines.zh: : 不管我有多爱您。在这栋房子里，我们对 Niki Nakayama 必须保持尊重。

lines.en: : Especially now that I’ve been accepted as her honorary little sister.
lines.zh: : 尤其是现在，我已经被接纳为她的荣誉妹妹了。

lines.en: : Oh, wonderful. Does this mean she’s gotten rid of her other one? Because that would confirm once and for all that Christmas miracles {i}are{/i} real.
lines.zh: : 哦，真棒。那是不是说明她把另一个妹妹给甩了？因为那样就能一劳永逸地证明圣诞奇迹{i}是真的{/i}。

lines.en: : Oh...right. Sorry, Maya. I know you get all grumpy whenever anything even remotely related to Noriko comes up.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。抱歉，Maya。我知道只要牵扯到任何跟 Noriko 沾边的事，你就会变得暴躁。

lines.en: : I don’t get {i}grumpy{/i}. I get murderous.
lines.zh: : 我不是{i}暴躁{/i}。我是想杀人。

lines.en: : You’re not giving my hatred enough credit.
lines.zh: : 你太低估我的恨意了。
: 我的错……

lines.en: : I think Niki’s going on soon, Sensei. So if you really {i}are{/i} tired and aren’t just trying to get away from a bunch of people who love you very much, you won’t have to wait around for long.
lines.zh: : 我想 Niki 快上场了，老师。所以如果您{i}真的是累了{/i}，而不是单纯想从一群非常爱您的人身边逃开，那您不用等太久。

lines.en: : {i}Also{/i}, if you just happen to find the mistletoe {i}that I hid in the medicine cabinet{/i} we can kill a few minutes by kissing in front of everyone!
lines.zh: : {i}还有{/i}，如果您碰巧找到了{i}我藏在药柜里的{/i}那株槲寄生，我们可以用「当着所有人的面接吻」来打发几分钟！

lines.en: : I...feel the need to...tell you that I don’t love-
lines.zh: : 我……觉得有必要……告诉你，我并不爱——

lines.en: : {i}Hi, everyone! Thank you all so much for coming out to see me on this very special holiday!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大家好！非常感谢大家在这个非常特别的节日里来看我！{/i}
: 啊！我的女王！她开口了！

lines.en: : Everyone shut up and gather around the TV!
lines.zh: : 所有人都给我闭嘴，围到电视前面来！

lines.en: Just as Ami asks, everyone directs their attention to the front of the room, but none do so as enthusiastically as she does.
lines.zh: 正如 Ami 所要求的，所有人都把注意力转向了房间前方，但没有一个人像她那么起劲。

lines.en: I think it’s a little weird how obsessed with my ex-girlfriend my [niece] is, but it’s not like she actively chose to be obsessed with her for that reason.
lines.zh: 我觉得我的[侄女]对我前女友着迷到这个地步有点奇怪，但她又不是主动因为那个理由才着迷的。

lines.en: And it’s not like I can expect her to stop now that-
lines.zh: 而且现在我也不能指望她停下来了，毕竟——

lines.en: : Sensei! Stop thinking! Niki is talking!
lines.zh: : 老师！别思考了！Niki 在讲话！

lines.en: : How could you hear me thinking?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能听见我在思考？
: 哇……她……真的很像 Noriko……

lines.en: : Oh, right! You listen to like...metal and stuff. Right, Sana?
lines.zh: : 哦，对！你听的是……金属乐什么的。对吧，Sana？

lines.en: : Yeah...I don’t know if...I’ve ever heard Niki’s music before.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不知道我……以前有没有听过 Niki 的歌。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll love it. She’s super talented and super pretty and super nice and-
lines.zh: : 我相信你会喜欢的。她超级有才华、超级漂亮、超级人好，而且——

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to get a little closer, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想再靠近一点吗，老师？

lines.en: : No thanks. I’ve seen Niki up close plenty of times.
lines.zh: : 不了，谢谢。Niki 我近距离看过很多次了。

lines.en: : Oh, no. I meant to me.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。我是说靠近我。
: 没人在看。
: 我还在这儿呢……

lines.en: : Okay. No one except {i}Maya{/i} is paying attention. And she {i}definitely doesn’t like you{/i}, so she won’t care at all.
lines.zh: : 好吧。除了 {i}Maya{/i} 没人看。而她{i}绝对不喜欢你{/i}，所以她一点都不会在意。

lines.en: : And super funny and super awesome and-
lines.zh: : 还有超级风趣、超级厉害，而且——

lines.en: : {i}Before I start singing...I just want you all to know that...you’re the reason I can do this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}在我开始唱歌之前……我只想让你们所有人知道……你们是我能做到这件事的理由。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’re what gives me the courage I never had when I was younger! And I think that you should have courage too!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们给了我年轻时从未有过的勇气！而我觉得，你们也该拥有勇气！{/i}
: {i}所以，请好好享受这首新歌吧！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Even if you’re one of those people who sometimes has a hard time enjoying anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哪怕你是那种有时候很难享受任何事物的人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It might come as a little bit of a surprise, but I used to be one of those people.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这可能会让你有点意外，但我以前也是那种人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’re never alone! Because you’ll always have me!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你永远不会孤单！因为你永远拥有我！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I’m never alone because I’ll always have you!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而我也永远不会孤单，因为我永远拥有你们！{/i}
: {i}奇迹是真的！{/i}
: {i}请欣赏！Tokimeki Labyrinth！{/i}
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！Niki！！我爱你！
{i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: : Noriko, I know you’ve probably heard this enough by now, but I really want your sister to just fucking go to town on me.
lines.zh: : Noriko，我知道这话你大概已经听够了，但我真的非常想让你姐姐狠狠地把我办了。

lines.en: : Is this just what you’re going to do from now on? Just constantly tell me about all of the people you want to fuck you?
lines.zh: : 这就是你今后打算干的事吗？就是不停跟我说，你想让哪些人操你？

lines.en: : Hey, don’t blame me for everyone else being like, crazy attractive and shit.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别怪我啊，谁让其他人都他妈那么有魅力呢。

lines.en: : I want you to fuck me too, but it’s not like I’m going to beg or anything.
lines.zh: : 我也想让你操我，但我又不会去求你什么的。

lines.en: : God! Fuck! Why does Nee-chan have to be so fucking perfect?! How do I compete with that?!
lines.zh: : 天啊！操！为什么姐姐非得那么他妈完美？！这让我怎么比？！

lines.en: : What if Sensei’s watching this right now?! What if he’s falling in love again as we speak?!
lines.zh: : 万一老师现在正在看呢？！万一他这会儿又爱上她了呢？！

lines.en: : If Sensei is watching this, it’s probably safe to assume he’s either: A) masturbating. Or B) fingering one of our classmates.
lines.zh: : 如果老师在看，大概可以安全地假设他要么：A）在自慰。要么 B）在用手指抠我们某个同学。

lines.en: : Thinking about it is just going to drive you crazy.
lines.zh: : 光是想这些，只会把自己逼疯。

lines.en: : How will hearing those options help?!
lines.zh: : 听这两个选项对我有什么帮助？！

lines.en: : Hey, why are you yelling at me?! I just wanted to watch your hot sister sing a Christmas song and now it’s suddenly counseling hour.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你冲我吼什么？！我只是想看看你那个辣姐姐唱首圣诞歌而已，结果突然就变成心理咨询时间了。

lines.en: : Ugh, I don’t know. I’m just really nervous about tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 唉，我不知道。我只是对明天真的很紧张。
: 为什么？你又不来。

lines.en: : I’m not {i}completely{/i} ditching the party. Didn’t I tell you I still planned on dropping by to give Sensei his present?
lines.zh: : 我又没说{i}完全{/i}不去派对。我不是跟你说过，我还是打算顺道过去把礼物给老师吗？

lines.en: : Probably, but it’s such a boring present that I must have just forgotten that conversation ever happened.
lines.zh: : 大概说过吧，不过那礼物太无聊了，我八成早就把这段对话忘得一干二净了。

lines.en: : It’s not boring! It has a load of sentimental value and the potential to change our relationship forever!
lines.zh: : 才不无聊！它承载着一大堆情感价值，还有永远改变我们关系的潜力！

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, whatever. If I were you, I’d just give him a handjob. He’d probably like that more.
lines.zh: : 好好好，随你。如果我是你，我就直接给他打个手枪。他大概会更喜欢那个。

lines.en: : Ugh. You’re such a fucking horny bitch.
lines.zh: : 呃。你真是个他妈的发情母狗。

lines.en: : Aww, thank you. That’s so sweet.
lines.zh: : 呜哇，谢谢。你真贴心。

lines.en: : FUCK! WHY IS SHE SO PERFECT?!
lines.zh: : 操！她为什么那么完美？！
{i}与此同时，就在我们刚才所在之处的下面……{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, I forgot to ask- are we still going shopping before the party tomorrow? I still have to get Nodoka a present.
lines.zh: : 哦，我忘了问——明天派对前我们还要去购物吗？我还得给 Nodoka 买份礼物。

lines.en: : Man, you got so lucky with your Secret Santa draw! I would have loved to get Futaba or Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 天哪，你 Secret Santa 抽得也太走运了！我要是抽到 Futaba 或 Nodoka 就好了。

lines.en: : Like, what the hell am I supposed to buy for Yasu? A hair brush?
lines.zh: : 说真的，我到底该给 Yasu 买什么啊？一把梳子？

lines.en: : I picked up my present on the way home today, but I’ll still come to the mall with you guys if you want me to.
lines.zh: : 我今天回家的路上已经把礼物买好了，不过你们要是想让我一起去商场，我还是会去的。

lines.en: : Dude, why wouldn’t we want you to? You’re part of the group. We love having you around.
lines.zh: : 老兄，我们干嘛不想让你去啊？你可是我们的一员。我们很喜欢你在这儿。

lines.en: : Just...so you two could maybe...be alone?
lines.zh: : 只是……好让你俩能……独处？

lines.en: : Oh, Otoha and I are taking it slow. We really only hold hands and cuddle and stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦，我和 Otoha 进展很慢的。我们真的就只是牵牵手、抱一抱什么的。

lines.en: : Alone time is for more serious couples who do serious stuff together. Right, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 独处时间，是留给那些会一起做正经事的、更认真的情侣的。对吧，Otoha？
: 呃……对。哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Well, since we’ll probably be gone all day tomorrow, I’ll just call my parents and wish them a merry Christmas now. I think they should still be awake.
lines.zh: : 那么，既然明天我们大概一整天都不在，我现在就给爸妈打个电话，祝他们圣诞快乐吧。我想他们应该还没睡。

lines.en: : Tell them I said hi! And that I love them! And that you are still somehow growing in the chest region despite already being miles ahead of everyone!
lines.zh: : 替我向他们问好！还有告诉他们我爱他们！还有，你明明已经遥遥领先所有人了，胸部居然还在长！

lines.en: : I’ll...make sure to do that, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我……一定转达，Rin……

lines.en: : Oh! And tell them I won’t mind if they decide to buy me a Christmas present this year!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有告诉他们，如果今年决定给我买份圣诞礼物，我一点都不介意！

lines.en: : I know they didn’t last year, so if you could {i}really{/i} just hammer in the fact that we’re basically sisters, it would be rad!
lines.zh: : 我知道他们去年没买，所以如果你能{i}狠狠强调{/i}一下我们基本上就是姐妹，那就太棒了！

lines.en: : I’ll...make sure to do that as well, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我……也会转达的，Rin……
: 你好暖。

lines.en: : I think I feel...pretty normal. Maybe you’re just cold?
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己……挺正常的。也许只是你冷？
: 也许吧。
: 你脸红了。

lines.en: : Is there a problem with blushing now?
lines.zh: : 现在脸红也有问题吗？

lines.en: : No. I just thought you looked cute.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是觉得你很可爱。
: 你……不是{i}一直都{/i}觉得我可爱吗？

lines.en: : Of course I think you’re always cute. I just also think there are times where you’re extra cute.
lines.zh: : 我当然一直觉得你可爱。我只是觉得，有些时候你会格外可爱。
: 比如现在。
: 怎么？你累了还是——
: 唔啾……唔唔……唔嗯~
: 唔噜……嗯……唔嗯…………唔唔唔~
: 嗯……那可真是……出乎意料。
: 再来一次？
: 好，请。
{i}几分钟后……{/i}

lines.en: : Hah...sorry about that. The conversation lasted a little longer than expected.
lines.zh: : 哈……抱歉。这通电话打得比预想的长了一点。

lines.en: : So, what time tomorrow were we...
lines.zh: : 那么，明天我们几点——
: 唔~唔嗯……Otoha……
: 啾……唔姆……唔~

lines.en: : Oh no. I seem to have forgotten to call my aunt as well. Please excuse me for...a longer amount of time.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我好像也忘了给我姑姑打电话。请允许我离开……更久一点。
: 啊唔……唔唔……唔！

lines.en: : WAAAAAAAAH! NIKI! YOU’RE THE ONLY PERSON WHO UNDERSTANDS ME!
lines.zh: : 哇啊啊啊啊！NIKI！你是唯一一个懂我的人！

lines.en: : Didn’t really like the song, but...I’m happy you...found someone you like so much...
lines.zh: : 那首歌我不太喜欢，不过……我很高兴你……找到了一个这么喜欢的人……

lines.en: : So, now that you’ve been forced to sit through whatever that was, are you still calling it a night?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然您被迫坐着看完了刚才那一堆东西，您还是要今晚就此收工吗？

lines.en: : Are you trying to get him to stay up later because you’ll {i}miss{/i} him, Maya?
lines.zh: : 你想让他晚点睡，是因为你会{i}想他{/i}吗，Maya？

lines.en: : No. I’m just smart enough to know that once he’s out of the picture, everyone else will inevitably want to go to sleep as well. And I am very tired.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是聪明到知道，一旦他不在画面里了，其他人必然会也想睡觉。而我非常困。

lines.en: : Or maybe...you’re just actually excited for the Christmas party tomorrow and don’t want to wait any longer.
lines.zh: : 或者也许……你其实就是很期待明天的圣诞派对，不想再等了。

lines.en: : Yup. You got me. Goodnight, everyone. I am so excited to be packed into a small, hot room with nineteen other girls tomorrow night.
lines.zh: : 对。被你说中了。大家晚安。明天晚上能和另外十九个女孩一起挤在一间又小又热的屋子里，我真是太期待了。

lines.en: Not seeing much reason to stay awake, I also decide to head to bed.
lines.zh: 找不到什么理由继续醒着，我也决定去睡了。

lines.en: This time, however, I decide to lock my door so Ayane can’t mount me in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 不过这一次，我决定把门锁上，这样 Ayane 就没法半夜骑上来了。

lines.en: I’m not really sure how tomorrow’s party will compare to last year’s (If...you can even call it {i}last{/i} year? How does that work exactly?) but, if there is anything I {i}do{/i} know...it’s that it’s going to be lively.
lines.zh: 我不太确定明天的派对跟去年的比起来会怎么样（如果……那也能叫{i}去年{/i}的话？这到底怎么算？），但如果说我{i}确实{/i}知道什么的话……那就是它一定会很热闹。

lines.en: The class size has nearly doubled and, unless we have some new venue planned out that I haven’t heard of, I think it’s pretty safe to assume that chaos will ensue and...
lines.zh: 班上的规模差不多翻了一倍，而且除非我们安排了什么我还没听说的新场地，我想可以相当有把握地假设：混乱将会降临，然后……

lines.en: I forgot to buy Miku a Christmas present...
lines.zh: 我忘了给 Miku 买圣诞礼物了……
算了。

lines.en: I’ll just buy one on the way back from Sara’s tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我明天从 Sara 那儿回来的路上买一个吧。
{i}Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!{/i}
{i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}
{i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}
{i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!{/i}
